evidence_sentences: An electric vehicle (EV) is a motor vehicle whose propulsion is powered fully or mostly by electricity.

Using electricity was among the preferred methods for motor vehicle propulsion as it provided a level of quietness, comfort and ease of operation that could not be achieved by the gasoline engine cars of the time.
Plug-in hybrid electric vehicles use electric motors as the primary propulsion method, rather than as a supplement.
Progress in batteries, electric motors and power electronics has made electric cars more feasible than during the 20th century.
